title: Execute high-risk approval gates
scope: Enforce YELLOW/RED approval requirements inside decide, including independent RED review
alternatives: Leave approval policy as descriptive metadata or weaken RED to a single owner decision
impact: High-risk proposals fail closed when expiry, approval records, or reviewer qualification are invalid
counter_evidence: Local named identities are self-declared and do not provide production authentication
acceptance_criteria: Expired, naive, missing approval, and unqualified reviewer fail; valid high-risk approval succeeds; GREEN semantics remain
rollback_reference: Revert the high-risk decide gate commit; retain existing proposal records as historical evidence.
